raw: Atta A. Van Den Kerkhof K. 90+1'

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' The linesman raises his flag. Benjamin Tetteh (Metz) is adjudged offside.
90+3' Joseph Nduquidi (Metz) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90+1' The referee signals a substitution. Arthur Atta (Metz) is brought on as a substitute for Kevin Van Den Kerkhof.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' Hakim Ben El Hadj shows a yellow card to Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) for a tough tackle.
87' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
87' Matthieu Udol (Metz) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Marseille earn a free kick.
85' Faris Moumbagna comes off the pitch to be replaced by Luis Henrique (Marseille).
84' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) launches a cross from the corner, but Alexandre Oukidja is alert to thwart the effort.

83' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) has a good opportunity as he meets a cross on the edge of the six-yard box and heads it towards the target. One of the defenders stands on the goal line and manages to keep the ball out. Now Marseille have a corner.
82' Jean Onana (Marseille) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Hakim Ben El Hadj ignores the protests.
80' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
79' Marseille fail to score from a corner as Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) leaps to collect the ball.
79' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes out of play. Marseille are awarded a corner kick.
77' Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar.
75' Here is a change. Georges Mikautadze is going off and Laszlo Boloni gives the last tactical orders to Benjamin Tetteh (Metz).
75' That's the end of the game for Didier Lamkel Ze, who is replaced by Cheikh Sabaly (Metz).
74' Hakim Ben El Hadj interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille).
72' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
70' The players claim that Joseph Nduquidi (Metz) handled the ball and it seems they are right. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Marseille.
68' Gennaro Gattuso decides to make a substitution. Iliman Ndiaye will be replaced by Ismaila Sarr (Marseille).
68' Here comes a substitution. Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) is brought on as a substitute for Quentin Merlin.
68' Ismael Traore (Metz) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
65' Jonathan Clauss floats over the free kick into a crowded box. Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) does well to win the ball, but sends his header just wide of the right post from close in.
64' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle for a foul. Marseille have a free kick.
62' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is flagged for offside.
61' 1 - 1 Goal! Lamine Camara swings the ball deep into the box and finds Matthieu Udol (Metz) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
60' Lamine Camara (Metz) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
60' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Good work from Metz as they win a corner.

56' 1 - 0 What a goal! Quentin Merlin plays it to Faris Moumbagna (Marseille), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Alexandre Oukidja into the bottom left corner. 1:0.

56' A neat pass is well received by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
55' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Pau Lopez is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
54' Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) wins the aerial duel to reach the cross from Iliman Ndiaye, but the ball slips off his head and flies well wide of the left post from close range.

52' Excellent touch by Georges Mikautadze (Metz)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.

51' Jean Onana (Marseille) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and low towards the middle of the target. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Alexandre Oukidja and his nice save.
48' Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
47' Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle after Ismael Traore (Metz) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Laszlo Boloni gives a chance to Joseph Nduquidi and Kevin N'Doram (Metz) is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Lamine Camara (Metz) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.
45+1' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
45+1' Lamine Camara (Metz) will take the corner.
45+1' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Corner kick. Metz will have an opportunity.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.

42' What a save from Alexandre Oukidja! Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising low header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out. The referee points to the corner flag and Marseille will take a corner.
41' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle for a foul.

39' What a poor attempt! Jean Onana (Marseille) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post.

38' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
34' Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle and it's Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
34' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
33' Substitution. Amine Harit will be replaced by Abdoul Bamo Meite (Marseille).
33' Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Marseille will take a corner kick.

31' From a seemingly non-threatining position, an indirect free kick is taken by Georges Mikautadze (Metz) which creates a surprising opportunity, but the opposition's defence is alert and thwarts his attempt at last possible moment.
31' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Samuel Gigot (Marseille) has to leave the pitch!
30' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Samuel Gigot (Marseille)! Let's see what he decides.
29' The foul by Samuel Gigot (Marseille) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Hakim Ben El Hadj.
28' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
27' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Quentin Merlin (Marseille), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
25' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the right post.

22' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Alexandre Oukidja was alert and the score remains the same.
22' Sadibou Sane (Metz) was too forceful with his tackle and Hakim Ben El Hadj interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
21' Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
20' Looks like Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
20' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) commits a foul during an attacking move.
18' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.

18' Kevin N'Doram (Metz) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Hakim Ben El Hadj blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
16' Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
15' Half-chance! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) plays a pass into the box, but Alexandre Oukidja reacts well to snuff out the attack.
13' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
10' Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
8' The resulting set piece from Metz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

8' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play and Metz have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) brings his opponent down. Hakim Ben El Hadj has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
1' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Metz.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Marseille will have the kick-off.
Hakim Ben El Hadj will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
